description: Java class FuelTunePane for UI-based fuel tuning, data collection, processing, and uploading in an automotive ECU tuning application.

classes.name: FuelTunePane
classes.description: UI component for fuel auto-tuning, data collection, processing, and uploading.

methods.name: uploadCurrentResult
methods.description: Uploads the current VE map to the controller and triggers a reload.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data into a table from byte array content at specified offset.

methods.name: initTable
methods.description: Initializes Table3D with size and scales.

methods.name: doJob
methods.description: Performs auto-tuning process, logs data, updates VE map, and enables upload.

methods.name: writeDataPoints
methods.description: Logs collected AFR data points to a file.

methods.name: logMap
methods.description: Logs a 2D map to a file.

methods.name: getTuneLogStream
methods.description: Creates or returns existing DataOutputStream for logging.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Converts a 2D double array to byte array in big-endian float format.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Sets up sensor listener and loads VE table data.

methods.name: reloadVeTable
methods.description: Reloads VE table data from controller content.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Loads a 2D map from byte array content at specified offset.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads a float array from controller byte buffer at specified offset.
